RAR 1.402 encrypted compressed split member, generated by the original DOS RAR.EXE under DOSBox-X:

    rar a -v2K -m3 -ppassword ESPLIT.RAR SOURCE.TXT

SOURCE.TXT is the first 32768 bytes of ../CMULTI.TXT. The password is `password`.
UnRAR 7.20 tests all three volumes successfully. The corresponding unencrypted
RAR 1.402 archive has byte-identical packed data after decrypting the encrypted
volumes with one continuous cipher state; restarting the cipher at each volume
boundary diverges at the first byte of ESPLIT.R00.
